type of slider interaction, e.g. "shift arrow click" / "shift bar click"
direction of the interaction when the slider is shifted, e.g. "forward" / "backward"
destination hostname of the clicked element
text of the clicked element
URL of the clicked element or downloaded file
form ID, e.g. "my-form"
e.g. "PDF"

or the entered search term for search filters, w/ "*Omitted!* user PII suspected" used for any search term value that looks like user PII
selected dropdown reason when applicable, e.g. "Reason: Just Saying Hi"
slide number that a user is on when clicking to slide elsewhere, e.g. "1-2" / "1"

boolean true / false based on internal= URL param, set as "true" when a page has "?internal=1" or "&internal=1" in the URL and have this persist through the DL indefinitely with value remembered on the browser until there's a visit with ?internal=0, set as "false" otherwise, to use for identifying when I'm reviewing my portfolio page to be able to filter out accordingly
scroll depth reached or % of page depth where scroll-to-top was clicked, e.g. "25" / "50" / "75" / "90" / "100
section of page if applicable, e.g. "#analytics" / "#ai" / "#operations" / "#leadership" / "#about"
title of section of page if applicable, e.g. "analytics" / "ai" / "operations" / "leadership" / "about"
title of the page, e.g. "Contact" / "Homepage" / "Work Samples" / "Skills + Tools"
type of page on the site, e.g. "home" / "skills + tools" / "contact" / "work samples"
full URL of the page, e.g. "https://gab-rodier.github.io/portfolio/work-samples/" / "https://gab-rodier.github.io/portfolio/"
query string of the page URL if applicable
number of results in the list after the filter is applied if applicable, e.g. "1"
search term of enabled search filter if one is applied in addition to the current filter selection, e.g. "platform"
name and selection of enabled filter option if there's another filter applied in addition to the current filter selection, e.g. "Level: Expert" / "Hostname: docs.larkspurlabs.com"
slide number that a user is clicking to, e.g. "2-3" / "2"

number of total slides that exist in the slider, e.g. "4" / "8";
or number of possible results in total when filters are not applied if applicable, e.g. "107"
